rec.name: Shop the Look (Shoppable Lifestyle Image with Hotspots + Product Carousel)
rec.status: Built — tested, documented (Slite guide), ready for reuse

what.text: A custom Shopify section (file ed-lookbook.liquid, named 'Shop the Look') that shows a large lifestyle image with pulsing white hotspot dots. On desktop, hovering a dot opens a small product card (thumbnail, title, price) next to it. Beside the image is a heading area (subheading plus headline with a hand-drawn highlight underline) and a product carousel. Each carousel card shows a product image, a rating badge, the vendor, the title, the price and variant swatches, plus an Add-to-Cart button that appears on hover. On tablet and mobile the hover popup is hidden and the carousel shows compact product rows with a small ATC link.

why.text: Shoppable lifestyle imagery lets shoppers see products in context, which inspires them and makes it easy to buy the whole look. Hotspots invite exploration, and the pulsing dot draws the eye without cluttering the image. The product details and ATC button sit next to the scene, so the path from inspiration to cart is short. This lifts product discovery, cross-selling and AOV. The rating badge adds light social proof.

how.text: 1) In the theme code, create the section file ed-lookbook.liquid and paste the provided code (the ticket's step-by-step guide is also in Slite). 2) In the theme editor, add the 'Shop the look' section to the page. 3) Upload the lifestyle image as the 'Thumbnail'. 4) Add one 'Heading' block (subheading and headline, optional custom fonts, sizes, letter spacing, text style, gaps and margin). 5) Add one 'Item' block per product and pick the product. Place its hotspot with percentage coordinates (distance from top and from left), so no pixel fiddling is needed. 6) Set colors, layout (Container or Full) and desktop/mobile spacing. The layout is a CSS grid: image on the left (about 2/3), heading and carousel on the right (about 1/3).

items: Section spacing top / bottom / left / right (desktop)
Section spacing top / bottom / left / right (mobile; left/right apply to Full layout only)
Heading block: subheading, headline (with highlight underline), optional custom fonts, sizes (desktop/mobile), letter spacing, text style, gap between items, bottom margin
Item block (one per product): product selection, hotspot position as % from top and % from left

Ticket wishlist (acceptance criteria, not all confirmed in the code): hotspots optional, pulse animation configurable, selectable product elements (title, reviews, price, teaser, variants, ATC button)

dependencies.text: Needs the Shopify theme to support custom sections (reference theme: 'Concept'). The carousel uses Swiper (a .swiper container with pagination bullets), so the theme must load Swiper. Product data comes from standard Shopify products (images, vendor, price, color variants as swatches). The rating badge probably needs a reviews app or metafield, but the source does not say which. The code file is cut off at the end, so the details of the final markup are unverified.

items: Click-through to PDPs from the section
Revenue per session and AOV for sessions that interact with the section
Scroll depth and engagement on the page where it is placed

images.caption: Desktop final UI: lifestyle image with two white pulsing hotspots, subheading and headline with orange highlight underline, product card with rating badge, vendor, title, price, color swatches and carousel pagination dots.

Theme editor: hover popup on a hotspot (thumbnail, title, price), and the section settings (text, background, layout Container/Full, thumbnail, desktop and mobile spacing) plus the Heading and Item blocks in the sidebar.
